title: aheadByForBranch and commitExistsForStory duplicate the best-effort `git fetch …
body: aheadByForBranch and commitExistsForStory duplicate the best-effort `git fetch origin main` + `git rev-parse origin/main` range-resolution scaffolding. A shared range-resolution helper would cut the duplication; the current per-adapter copy is acceptable and matches existing style (already noted in the PRD review round).
